description: This PHP script handles the installation and setup of the TestLink database, including connection checks, database creation, schema updates, user creation, and configuration file writing.

classes.name: SqlParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing and executing SQL files during installation.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Class providing detailed database object management, including table and view metadata.

methods.name: write_config_db
methods.description: Writes database configuration details to a PHP config file.

methods.name: drop_tables
methods.description: Drops all existing tables in the database to allow reinstallation.

methods.name: drop_views
methods.description: Drops all existing views in the database.

methods.name: manual_operations
methods.description: Outputs instructions for manual database operations post-installation.
